facts.fact: The historic centre was inscribed on the World Heritage List in 1991. The property concerns the urban ensemble, not just one church.
facts.location: Inscription information near the end of the property page

facts.fact: Its sixteenth-century plan combines Spanish Renaissance ideas and Mesoamerican experience, adapting to hillside terrain; characteristic regional pink stone unifies different architectural periods.
The registered ensemble retains its original street layout and includes plazas and gardens; a walking route can explain its urban design.
facts.excerpt: streets still follow the original layout
